## About this round

Wema Bank Hackaholics 7.0 Women-Led category second place, N10,000,000 cash award presented at the grand finale in Lagos on 6 Nov 2026 (date\_announced = finale date per TechBuild and Guardian). Winner named as Precious Zino of URI (TechBuild, Guardian); catalog name URI Social (urisocial.com). Press calls it funding; recorded as Grant, consistent with the Hackaholics prize precedent. NGN only; no USD amount sourced.
